source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
As the battle begins, you may place 1 Teleport Homer token on the battlefield for this unit. If you do:

- When this unit is the target of your **[Rapid Ingress stratagem](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress)**, you may use the Teleport Homer token. That use costs 1 CP less, but the unit must be placed within 3" of the Teleport Homer token and more than 8" from every enemy unit. Afterwards, remove the Teleport Homer token.
- The Teleport Homer token is also removed if an enemy unit finishes a move 1" or less from it.

detail.trigger: owning unit selected for Rapid Ingress; token available
